description.zh:
素材ID，多个素材以逗号（,）分隔；最多支持10个素材ID。
>  关联多个素材时应保证多个素材均为同一类型，且与MaterialType取值对应。
description.en:
Separate multiple material IDs with commas (,). You can specify up to 10 IDs.

>  If you specify multiple materials, make sure that the materials are of the same type as specified in MaterialType.

description.zh:
素材类型。取值：
- **video**：视频。
- **audio**：纯音频。
- **image**：图片。
description.en:
The type of the material. Valid values:

*   **video**
*   **audio**
*   **image**
The ID of the online editing project.

title.zh: 增加剪辑工程关联素材

example.unifiedCli: aliyun vod add-editing-project-materials --project-id afa31b483b5c41609185de0e1b790579 --material-ids d3251979f9fd41f2acb29ccda5a6f772 --material-type video --region cn-hangzhou
